complexity.notes: The iterative version cleanly drops the previous submission's O(log n) recursion stack to O(1) space, and the terminal `nums[start] != target` check handles both the one-element window and the empty-array edge. For production code the stdlib `bisect` module would spell this in a couple of lines, but writing it out is the point of the exercise.
complexity.summary: Iterative binary search over the half-open interval [start, end), narrowing the window by comparing nums[mid] to target, with a final check of the single remaining element when the loop exits.
